bottleDescription: Close-up photograph (1271x721) of the back label on a real spirits bottle. The printed text names the Crown Royal Company, 750 mL, product of Canada. The label is dark burgundy with gold text, a boxed government warning, and a barcode. Curved clear glass and amber spirit show at both edges. No whole-bottle silhouette and no closure appear in the frame, so this reference gives Gemini label surface and label curvature only, never bottle geometry.

scenes.setting: a plain dark-walnut desk in a windowless office, with a matte charcoal wall close behind the bottle
scenes.lighting: One soft light comes from above and outside the frame. The light points down onto the label. The wall and the desk stay in shadow.
